discoverySources.name: Eater SF
discoverySources.scope: All entries currently exposed by the publisher feed. Previously collected URLs are retained; not an exhaustive article archive.

discoverySources.name: Mission Local
discoverySources.scope: All entries currently exposed by the publisher feed. Previously collected URLs are retained; not an exhaustive article archive.

discoverySources.name: Port of San Francisco development projects
discoverySources.scope: Every card in Projects In Development. Area-wide policies and completed-project archives excluded. Discovery only; lifecycle, phases and locations require review.

discoverySources.name: SFUSD active bond-program project pages
discoverySources.scope: Every leaf subpage listed under the active 2024 and 2016 bond programs. Includes program-wide work; absence of explicit completion status remains unresolved. Discovery only; lifecycle, phases and locations require review.

sources.name: SF Planning · Development Pipeline
sources.note: Citywide filed development proposals, approved projects and construction. Does not include every business opening or early concept.

sources.name: MOHCD · Affordable Housing Pipeline
sources.note: Published construction-completion estimates. Completion is not necessarily the move-in date.

sources.name: SFCTA · MyStreetSF
sources.note: Transportation projects funded or overseen by SFCTA. Closed projects are excluded. The source does not expose a dataset-wide update date.

sources.name: Reviewed operator announcements & local reporting
sources.note: Manually reviewed evidence. Month/season/year windows preserve uncertainty. This is not a complete index of announcements.

sources.name: SF registered business locations
sources.note: upper(city) = 'SAN FRANCISCO' AND location_end_date IS NULL AND location_start_date >= '2025-09-05T00:00:00'

sources.name: SFMTA project directory
sources.note: Union of every page in the unfiltered directory and all nine status filters. Includes programs and studies. URLs are deduplicated; publication ordering can vary.

sources.name: SF Rec & Park active project directory
sources.note: Active Park Projects directory plus grouped Active projects in park subdirectories. Includes programs; explicitly completed directory entries are retained separately.

sources.name: SF Public Works directory and project map
sources.note: Every project card on the directory and every published project-map marker; includes completed historical work.

sources.name: SFPUC San Francisco construction projects
sources.note: Every link in the San Francisco accordion. Other regional sections excluded. Agency region labels can include cross-boundary infrastructure.

limitations: Registration and permit dates are not opening dates.
Business registration import includes all industries; missing industry codes remain Other.
Permit lead selection uses business-use keywords and can include unrelated alterations.
ABC bulk and direct daily imports returned HTTP 403; browser-readable daily reports are not automated yet.
Park, Public Works and SFPUC directories are connected; detailed phases, schools and neighborhood reporting remain incomplete.
